channel.title: You Don't Need More Followers To Make Money
channel.description: Most coaches are working hard — but focused on the wrong thing. In this episode, Indrodip Ghosh (founder of The5th) challenges one of the most deeply held beliefs in the online business world: that you need a bigger audience to create real income. Spoiler? You don't. Indrodip breaks down the "follower trap" — why chasing metrics feels productive but rarely leads to clients — and shares the three things that actually move the needle: Clarity, Connection, and Conversation. He also gets honest about why so many smart, capable coaches keep postponing the deeper work, hiding behind content strategy and visibility goals instead of having real conversations. If you're tired of posting and hoping — and you're ready to grow your coaching business with the audience you already have — this episode is for you. In this episode: Why followers don't equal trust (and trust is what creates clients). The 3 things coaches who grow consistently do differently. A simple 7-day challenge to shift your focus from metrics to real connection. Free resource: Take Indrodip's free 20-question quiz at quiz.the5th.consulting to get your personalised 15-day roadmap to your first $5,000 — plus access to AI coaching to help you execute it.
